captions.title: Listings is in the Menu
captions.line: Tap Menu at the bottom right, then Listings.

captions.title: Search what the buyer wants
captions.line: An area, an estate or a home's name, such as Lekki.

captions.title: For sale or for rent
captions.line: Switch lists to match what the buyer is after.

captions.title: Check the home
captions.line: Its photo, the area and the price, ready to send.

captions.title: Tap Share
captions.line: It goes out with your invite code in the link.

message.label: The message the buyer gets
message.text: Have a look at this home on AV Homes: Tropical Oasis, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos. ₦245,000,000.
